children: EQT is increasing its quarterly dividend by 3% to 17 cents a share, up from 16 and a half cents.
The new payout, equal to 68 cents a year, represents a 1.3% annual yield based on the natural-gas producer's Wednesday closing price of $52.75.
The dividend is payable on Dec. 1 to shareholders of record as of Nov. 4.
